items.headline: Sesko forced to miss international break with recurring injury concern
items.summary: Benjamin Sesko suffered a setback during Carabao Cup loss to Brighton and missed Fulham draw. Reports suggest recurrence of chronic shin injury with no clear return timeframe.

items.headline: United may need January striker signing due to Sesko fitness concerns
items.summary: Manchester United could be forced into January transfer activity with ongoing uncertainty over Benjamin Sesko's availability and potential €40m deal being considered.
